verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK that covers conversion, structured extraction, pipelines, form filling and file management, so the parse and extract parts of the story are present on the Python side. Nothing in the evidence mentions a TypeScript SDK, typed models, or SDK-level job/webhook handling (webhooks are documented only at the API level), and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: official TypeScript SDK, evidence of typed interfaces, SDK coverage of jobs/async polling, documented sensible defaults, independent or hands-on corroboration.
